info.title: SOA Graduation Project Management API
info.description: Gateway-facing APIs. Roles: 1 administrator, 2 lecturer, 3 student. Lecturers can create pending topics assigned to themselves, read assigned topics and grade their students; they cannot update/delete/approve topics or cancel/purge registrations. Swagger does not bypass service authorization. Static contract: update alongside route/DTO changes. Audit fields are server-controlled. Do not blindly replay uncertain writes; reconcile using detail GET first. Internal auth and Django admin endpoints are intentionally excluded. Log-service has no implemented public business API.

get.description: Both /api/ and /api/v1/ aliases are supported. Authenticated reads. Lecturer role 2 list/detail is restricted to advisor_id matching JWT user_id; unassigned/other topics return 404 on detail. Role 1 may POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE. Role 2 may POST only: status is forced to 0 and advisor_id to JWT user_id before academic reference validation. Status: 0 pending, 1 approved, 2 open registration, 3 closed registration. Topic ID is immutable. Omitted status is preserved on PUT/PATCH; admin API creation defaults to 1; lecturer creation always uses 0. PUT clears omitted description, file_url and advisor_id. Names may be null during display-service outages. DELETE closes the topic, purges all registrations including history through REST, then deletes the topic; 503 deletion_incomplete may leave it closed with registration history already removed. Reconcile before explicit retry.

put.description: Both /api/ and /api/v1/ aliases are supported. Authenticated reads. DELETE closes the topic, purges all registrations including history through REST, then deletes the topic; 503 deletion_incomplete may leave it closed with registration history already removed. Reconcile before explicit retry.

post.description: Student role 3. Topic must be open (status 2) and belong to the student faculty. Only one current registration. Exact repeated topic/semester returns existing registration (200); new registration returns 201. Do not blindly retry uncertain writes. New registrations also require gpa >= req_GPA and active distinct student count < studentQuota. GPA rejection: 400 gpa_requirement_not_met; full quota: 409 topic_quota_full. Capacity count/check/insert share a local writer transaction; external GPA and topic lookups are not atomic with concurrent policy edits. Equivalent existing registrations remain idempotent after GPA/quota changes.
